name: superdev
description: 15 skills and 41 agents that take a product from a PRD and a design to a released, verified Navree app: the Navree CLI and Navree's own skills first, a plan and each module's contract on disk before code, one module at a time with runtime and browser proof, then a security review, an audit, a QA gate where every cell cites evidence, and deployment with Navree's tools. Screens in Navree UI or Next.js; optional Tauri clients.

interface.shortDescription: Build, audit and ship Navree apps from a PRD and a design.
interface.longDescription: Superdev gives Codex the process for building a product on Navree: the Navree CLI and skills first, a confirmed plan and per-module contracts on disk, one verified module at a time on Navree UI or a Next.js front end, then a security review, a product audit, a QA gate and deployment. Its 41 agents are role prompts that Codex runs through skills and explicit delegation.
defaultPrompt: Use Superdev to build this product on Navree from my PRD and design.
Use Superdev to audit this Navree app before release.
Use Superdev to move this prototype to Navree.
